mathematical_meanings: Left image: The shading selects the area bounded by the three semicircular arcs. Right image: The shaded half-plane is the solution region of a strict linear inequality.
Rationales: The feature selects a geometric area in the left image and selects the solution half-plane of a linear inequality in the right image. The pale blue patch inside the large semicircle and above the two smaller ones. The gray half-plane to the right of the rising dashed boundary.
